subtasks.description: Implement a real mono diarization adapter with pinned community-1 or a better measured qualified model.
Preserve anonymous speaker clusters and overlap intervals separately from display-exclusive turns.
Reconcile speaker identities across long-call chunks and constrain counts only when source evidence supports them.
Align words/turns to speaker intervals and original recording offsets; retain ambiguous/unknown assignments.
Calibrate confidence/quality flags using held-out annotations; do not convert similarity into unsupported probability.
Add timeline representation for overlapping speech and correction-ready turn attribution.
Evaluate DER/JER, count errors, role accuracy and span offsets, publishing collar/overlap/unknown policies.
